operating_rules.codex_role: Write dispatch, read external receipts, review evidence and submit acceptance decisions.

objective: Complete Batch 16 with at least 20 evidenced voucher, counter-offer or combo candidates for Da Nang and prepare an integrated v3.426.0 release candidate.

locality_rules.inheritance: Reuse traceable same-brand official branch evidence; record source hash and observed time. Branch presence alone does not prove item availability, price or promotion applicability.

execution.resume_rule: Inspect existing Batch 16 artifacts and incomplete runs first; preserve historical evidence and avoid redundant captures.
execution.capture: Save actual response body bytes, sanitized response headers, actual UTC capture time, requested and final URL, HTTP status and SHA-256 in a unique run directory.
execution.validation: Validate every extracted offer against captured source content, terms, dates and locality evidence. Deduplicate against the existing commercial catalog. Publish counts separately for newly added and existing items.
execution.staging: Hydrate eligible items into commercial Staging :4176 and test rendered IDs, prices, conditions, keyboard interaction and viewport 1440/768/390.
execution.shortfall: Report actual accepted counts and concrete per-brand blockers if fewer than 20 qualify. Never synthesize items or mark failed gates PASS.

content_requirements.voucher_copy: Enable copy only for an actual public code in source evidence; app-claim and counter offers must retain their distinct actions.
content_requirements.prices: Preserve currency, eligibility, model or combo scope and observation time; do not describe a listed price as a discount without supporting evidence.
content_requirements.validity: Exclude expired offers from active offers; clearly flag unpublished end dates rather than inventing them.
content_requirements.split_bill: Prepare card-level client-side bill splitting and user-initiated copy/share text without collecting personal data.
content_requirements.affiliate_radar: Prepare integration only for evidenced official partner feed items and authentic partner URLs; report unavailable feed access without inventing credentials or links.

production.release_gate: Submit integrated candidate, fingerprints, automated tests and rollback plan for release approval; do not mutate live Production under this work order.

delivery.immutability: Use exclusive creation for receipts. If the canonical receipt already exists, preserve it and emit a new run-specific receipt with a reference to the previous one.
delivery.acceptance: Codex reviews the actual delivered receipt and evidence; creation of this dispatch does not establish that external Antigravity has received or executed it.
